# The same transaction with its splits cut off.
#
# A transaction block needs only its date, flag and description to parse, so a
# file cut short by a failed write still reads as a transaction — and under
# `--strategy update` the block is the source of truth for the splits, which
# is what lets a person remove one by removing a line.
#
# Nothing told that apart from a file that stops here, so the transaction was
# left with no splits: a transaction with no money in it.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the transaction, with its
# splits left alone.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_transaction_block_with_no_splits.py.
2026-02-01 * "Lunch"
	guid: "cccccccccccccccccccccccccccc0001"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
